name: token-optimizer
description: Hands a session over to a fresh one at a context threshold: /compress, /clear, /whats-next, with NEXT.md carried over

auto.title: Auto chain
auto.description: Start the chain by itself once the context reaches the threshold (off: only /tokopt-chain)

threshold.title: Threshold (tokens)
threshold.description: Context size that starts the chain

injectNext.title: Hand NEXT.md over after /clear
injectNext.description: Give the conversation after /clear the NEXT.md as context
